'''Palm lasers''' were [[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapons with a range of twelve [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Modified [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] employed as [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droids]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] were armed with palm lasers.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
